note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), who transcribed the description of Maiti (1983); the original is in English, soldier and worker known, alate unknown; the worker body length is given in the original as '4.15-4-35' and is treated as 4.35 owing to a misread OCR hyphen; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide, without a V-shaped suture; mandibles short and robust, sickle-shaped, base very wide, about half the head length; the small tooth of the left mandible situated slightly behind the apical third, with 2 additional minute basal denticles, the tooth of the right mandible slightly smaller; postmentum long, club-shaped, widest at about the anterior third, waist relatively wide, constriction index 0.78; pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a median notch. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule cream yellow, slightly darker posteriorly; antennae, labrum, legs and abdomen white; mandibles dark brown, paler at the base; pronotum paler than the head. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Body length 4.20–4.60 mm. Head capsule subrectangular, longer than wide; head length to mandible base 1.38 mm, maximum width 1.11 mm; without a V-shaped suture. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2, segment 4 nearly equal to segment 3 in length. Anteclypeus transparent, yellowish white, hairless; postclypeus hairy, sub-trapezoidal, flat. Labrum broadly tongue-shaped, wider than long; length 0.21 mm, width 0.32 mm; hairy, hairs scattered over the labral body and near the anterior margin. Mandibles short and robust, sickle-shaped, base very wide; length 0.69 mm, basal width 0.42 mm; about half the head length, mandible-head length index 0.50. Left mandible with a small tooth situated slightly behind the apical third (tooth distance from apex 0.24 mm) and 2 minute basal denticles; right mandible with a slightly smaller tooth at the apical third (tooth distance from apex 0.25 mm) and 1 additional minute basal denticle. Postmentum long, club-shaped, widest at about the anterior third, from there the sides curving weakly inward to a relatively wide waist; length 0.96 mm, maximum width 0.38 mm, waist width 0.30 mm, constriction index (waist width/maximum width) 0.78. Pronotum strongly saddle-shaped, anterior margin without a median notch, posterior margin slightly concave in the middle; length 0.38 mm, width 0.61 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule milky white, paler anteriorly; antennae, labrum, legs and thorax white; abdomen blackish owing to gut contents showing through. Head and body with relatively dense hairs. Body length 4.15–4.35 mm. Head subcircular, wider than long; head length to mandible base 0.69–0.73 mm, maximum width 0.80–0.90 mm. Anteclypeus transparent, hairless, sub-trapezoidal; postclypeus raised and hairy, length about half its width; length 0.15–0.20 mm, width 0.30–0.40 mm. Labrum wide, tongue-shaped, with a few short and long hairs on the labral body and near the anterior margin; length 0.22–0.27 mm, width 0.31–0.39 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25–0.28 mm, width 0.48–0.53 mm.
